changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO str_rn.accommodation_activity ( activity_id, platform_id, rn, accommodation_id, period_from, period_to, overnight_stays, guest_count, received_at, purge_after ) WITH months AS ( SELECT g::date AS period_from, (g + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::date AS period_to, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM g)::int AS cal_month, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY g)::int AS month_idx FROM generate_series(DATE '2026-01-01', DATE '2026-06-01', INTERVAL '1 month') AS g ), rns AS ( SELECT rn.rn, rn.accommodation_id, GREATEST(COALESCE(a.max_beds, 2), 1) AS beds, -- Priobalne županije se prepoznaju uzorkom, ne točnom jednakošću: -- na CDU-u vrijednost može biti sa ili bez sufiksa " županija". (a.county ILIKE ANY (ARRAY[ '%Splitsko%', '%Šibensko%', '%Zadarsk%', '%Istarsk%', '%Primorsko%', '%Dubrovačko%', '%Ličko%' ])) AS coastal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rn.rn)::int AS rn_idx FROM str_rn.registration_number rn JOIN str_rn.accommodation a ON a.accommodation_id = rn.accommodation_id WHERE rn.status = 'ACTIVE' ), platforms AS ( SELECT platform_id, CASE WHEN name = 'Airbnb' THEN 60 ELSE 40 END AS share_pct, CASE WHEN name = 'Airbnb' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS platform_idx FROM str_rn.online_platform WHERE name IN ('Airbnb', 'Booking.com') ), occupancy AS ( SELECT r.rn, r.accommodation_id, r.beds, r.coastal, r.rn_idx, m.period_from, m.period_to, m.month_idx, (m.period_to - m.period_from + 1) AS days_in_month, -- Popunjenost u postotku ležaj-noći. Priobalje ima izražen ljetni -- vrhunac, kontinentalni objekti ravnomjeran promet kroz godinu. CASE WHEN r.coastal THEN CASE m.cal_month WHEN 1 THEN 4 WHEN 2 THEN 5 WHEN 3 THEN 9 WHEN 4 THEN 17 WHEN 5 THEN 29 WHEN 6 THEN 54 WHEN 7 THEN 78 WHEN 8 THEN 84 WHEN 9 THEN 44 WHEN 10 THEN 19 WHEN 11 THEN 7 ELSE 11 END ELSE CASE m.cal_month WHEN 1 THEN 14 WHEN 2 THEN 16 WHEN 3 THEN 20 WHEN 4 THEN 24 WHEN 5 THEN 29 WHEN 6 THEN 33 WHEN 7 THEN 35 WHEN 8 THEN 34 WHEN 9 THEN 31 WHEN 10 THEN 24 WHEN 11 THEN 17 ELSE 21 END END AS fill_pct FROM rns r CROSS JOIN months m ), totals AS ( SELECT o.*, GREATEST(1, ROUND( (o.beds * o.days_in_month * o.fill_pct / 100.0)::numeric )::int) AS bed_nights, -- Prosječno trajanje boravka: priobalje ~5 noćenja, kontinent ~2.5. CASE WHEN o.coastal THEN 5.0 ELSE 2.5 END AS avg_stay FROM occupancy o ) SELECT ('cd000000-0000-0000-' || LPAD(t.rn_idx::text, 4, '0') || '-' || LPAD(t.month_idx::text, 2, '0') || LPAD(p.platform_idx::text, 2, '0') || '00000000')::uuid, p.platform_id, t.rn, t.accommodation_id, t.period_from, t.period_to, GREATEST(1, ROUND((t.bed_nights * p.share_pct / 100.0)::numeric)::int), -- Broj gostiju nikad ne smije premašiti broj noćenja te platforme. LEAST( GREATEST(1, ROUND((t.bed_nights * p.share_pct / 100.0)::numeric)::int), GREATEST(1, ROUND((t.bed_nights / t.avg_stay * p.share_pct / 100.0)::numeric)::int) ), (t.period_to + INTERVAL '1 day')::timestamptz, ((t.period_to + INTERVAL '1 day')::timestamptz + INTERVAL '18 months') FROM totals t CROSS JOIN platforms p;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM str_rn.accommodation_activity WHERE activity_id::text LIKE 'cd000000-0000-0000-%'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO str_rn.guest (guest_id, activity_id, country, guest_count) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), aa.activity_id, cs.country, GREATEST(1, CEIL(aa.guest_count * cs.share)::int) FROM str_rn.accommodation_activity aa JOIN str_rn.accommodation a ON a.accommodation_id = aa.accommodation_id JOIN (VALUES ('coast', 'Njemačka', 0.45), ('coast', 'Italija', 0.25), ('coast', 'Austrija', 0.20), ('coast', 'Slovenija', 0.10), ('inland', 'Njemačka', 0.45), ('inland', 'Austrija', 0.30), ('inland', 'Slovenija', 0.25) ) AS cs(profile, country, share) ON cs.profile = CASE WHEN a.county ILIKE ANY (ARRAY[ '%Splitsko%', '%Šibensko%', '%Zadarsk%', '%Istarsk%', '%Primorsko%', '%Dubrovačko%', '%Ličko%' ]) THEN 'coast' ELSE 'inland' END WHERE aa.activity_id::text LIKE 'cd000000-0000-0000-%' AND aa.guest_count > 0;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM str_rn.guest WHERE activity_id::text LIKE 'cd000000-0000-0000-%'
